PR #108 open for h07-1 (measure.ts + decide.ts). h05: in loop.ts call decideWithConfirm(direction, before, after, remeasure) where remeasure measures the kept version and the candidate again; use its returned before.value/after.value for result.json. decide() alone is only the 10% screen and will fail P06. failedGuard(checkout, problem) -> command|null; guardFailure() -> {guard, reason}.
